en.headline: Patrolling robot damaged after falling down staircase at Hong Kong airport
en.dek: The Airport Authority said a humanoid robot tumbled down a staircase in Terminal One during a test run on Saturday, resulting in partial damage with no injuries reported.
body: A patrolling robot was damaged after falling down a staircase at Hong Kong International Airport during a test run on Saturday, the Airport Authority Hong Kong said.

The incident occurred in a non-public area of the arrival hall in Terminal One, where the staircase led to an emergency exit. The silver-and-black humanoid robot, which has a head, two arms and hands, broke into pieces at the bottom of the stairs. Staff from the robot operations contractor were present and monitored the entire testing process.

The Airport Authority confirmed the robot sustained partial damage and that no one was injured. Authorities are investigating the accident. The robot was undergoing a trial for patrolling operations at the airport.

zh.headline: 機場巡邏機械人測試期間墮梯損毀
zh.dek: 機場管理局表示，一部人形機械人周六在一號客運大樓進行測試時墮下樓梯，局部損毀，無人受傷。
body: 機場管理局表示，一部巡邏機械人周六在香港國際機場進行測試時墮下樓梯損毀。
事故發生在一號客運大樓抵港大堂非公眾範圍的緊急出口樓梯。銀黑相間的人形機械人擁有頭部、雙臂及雙手，墮至梯底後局部損毀。機械人營運承辦商職員在場監察整個測試過程。
機管局確認機械人局部損毀，無人受傷，當局正調查事故。該機械人當時正進行機場巡邏運作的試驗。
